items.q: Which gas makes up most of the atmosphere?
items.qAf: Watter gas maak die meeste van die atmosfeer uit?
items.explain: Nitrogen makes up about 78% of the air; oxygen about 21%.
items.explainAf: Stikstof maak ongeveer 78% van die lug uit; suurstof ongeveer 21%.

items.q: In which layer of the atmosphere does most weather occur?
items.qAf: In watter laag van die atmosfeer kom die meeste weer voor?
items.explain: The troposphere is the lowest layer, where clouds and weather form.
items.explainAf: Die troposfeer is die laagste laag, waar wolke en weer vorm.

items.q: Why does the temperature drop as you go up through the troposphere?
items.qAf: Waarom daal die temperatuur soos jy deur die troposfeer opgaan?
options: Air is less dense and less heat is held near the ground
optionsAf: Lug is ligter en minder hitte word naby die grond vasgehou
items.explain: Most heating comes from the ground warmed by the Sun, so temperature falls with height in the troposphere.
items.explainAf: Meeste verhitting kom van die grond wat deur die son verwarm word, so die temperatuur daal met hoogte in die troposfeer.

items.q: Which layer contains the ozone layer?
items.explain: The ozone layer is in the stratosphere and absorbs most harmful ultraviolet radiation.
items.explainAf: Die osoonlaag is in die stratosfeer en absorbeer die meeste skadelike ultraviolet straling.

items.q: What does the ozone layer protect us from?
items.explain: Ozone absorbs most ultraviolet radiation from the Sun, reducing skin damage.
items.explainAf: Osoon absorbeer die meeste ultraviolet straling van die son, en verminder velskade.

items.q: Which substance was found to damage the ozone layer and has been phased out?
items.qAf: Watter stof is gevind om die osoonlaag te beskadig en is uitgefaseer?
items.explain: CFCs release chlorine that destroys ozone, so their use was banned under the Montreal Protocol.
items.explainAf: KFK’s stel chloor vry wat osoon vernietig, so die gebruik daarvan is onder die Montreal-protokol verbied.

items.q: The lowest layer of the atmosphere, where weather happens.
items.qAf: Die laagste laag van die atmosfeer, waar weer plaasvind.

items.q: The layer of the atmosphere that contains the ozone layer.
items.qAf: Die laag van die atmosfeer wat die osoonlaag bevat.

items.q: The most abundant gas in air (about 78%).
items.qAf: Die mees volopste gas in lug (omtrent 78%).

items.q: The gas in the stratosphere that absorbs harmful ultraviolet radiation.
items.qAf: Die gas in die stratosfeer wat skadelike ultravioletstraling absorbeer.

items.text: Air is about 78% nitrogen and about [[]]% oxygen. Chemicals called [[]] used in old fridges and aerosols damage the ozone layer.
items.textAf: Lug is omtrent 78% stikstof en omtrent [[]]% suurstof. Chemikalieë genaamd [[]] wat in ou yskaste en spuitkannetjies gebruik is, beskadig die osoonlaag.

items.text: In the troposphere the temperature [[]] as you go higher. The layer furthest from Earth is the [[]].
items.textAf: In die troposfeer [[]] die temperatuur hoe hoër jy gaan. Die laag die verste van die Aarde is die [[]].

items.q: The ozone layer is in the troposphere.
items.qAf: Die osoonlaag is in die troposfeer.
items.explain: False. The ozone layer is in the stratosphere.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Die osoonlaag is in die stratosfeer.

items.q: Meteors burn up in the mesosphere.
items.qAf: Meteore brand in die mesosfeer uit.
items.explain: True. Friction with the air in the mesosphere heats them until they burn up.
items.explainAf: Waar. Wrywing met die lug in die mesosfeer verhit hulle totdat hulle uitbrand.

items.q: Air pressure decreases with height above sea level.
items.qAf: Lugdruk neem af met hoogte bo seevlak.
items.explain: True. There is less air above you, so it pushes down with less force.
items.explainAf: Waar. Daar is minder lug bo jou, dus druk dit met minder krag af.

items.q: Put the layers of the atmosphere in order, from the Earth's surface upwards.
items.qAf: Rangskik die lae van die atmosfeer in volgorde, van die Aarde se oppervlak na bo.

items.q: Explain why damage to the ozone layer is a danger to people.
items.qAf: Verduidelik waarom skade aan die osoonlaag ’n gevaar vir mense is.
points: More ultraviolet (UV) radiation reaches the Earth's surface.
UV causes sunburn, skin cancer and eye damage (cataracts).
pointsAf: Meer ultravioletstraling (UV) bereik die Aarde se oppervlak.
UV veroorsaak sonbrand, velkanker en oogskade (katarakte).
